text: This report responds to a request from Councillor Neethan Shan to review the feasibility of installing traffic control signals on Steeles Avenue East at Eastvale Drive (City of Markham). Currently, this intersection is controlled by a stop sign for southbound traffic on Eastvale Drive at Steeles Avenue East.

Scarborough Community Council deferred consideration of the item until the July 4, 2018 meeting of Scarborough Community Council to get further information from the TTC, Toronto Hydro and Transportation Services.
